content: Human-labeling session — econ-deny-enemy-expansion:easy seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is an expansion-denial raid. You hold your Construction Yard (fact) and four medium tanks (2tnk) at the west edge. The enemy just dropped a forward Ore Refinery (proc) and a harvester (harv, unarmed ore truck) at mid-map (60,20), guarded by a single rifle infantryman (e1). Their main base sits far east at (108,20), bristling with pillboxes and rocket infantry — too hard to crack in budget. Within about 60 turns, raze the forward refinery, keep at least two of your tanks alive, and keep your Construction Yard standing.
